title: Selma Blair arrested at JFK after she allegedly attacked flight attendants
description:
Several news outlets reported Blair allegedly punched a flight attendant, bit another and tried to open plane door

The actor Selma Blair was arrested on Sunday at John F Kennedy (JFK) airport in New York on allegations that she attacked flight attendants on a Delta Air Lines flight, according to officials.

Blair’s arrest happened at about 11am, after Port Authority of New York and New Jersey officials said they responded to a call “about a physically abusive passenger aboard Delta Air Lines flight 938 which was parked at the gate” at JFK after arriving from Los Angeles (LAX).
